text:
Like the breeze that cools the blood
above the dark battlefield,
bearing perfumes and harmonies
through the wandering silence of night,

symbol of sorrow and tenderness
in the English bard's dreadful drama,
sweet Ophelia, her reason lost,
passes by gathering flowers and singing.

translation.title: Rhyme VI: Like the Breeze That Cools the Blood
